A type of '''transport''' was utilized by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The transport, which had a hangar bay on either side protected by force fields, saw use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as well as the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]], where at least one of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] crashed.<ref name="SWTOR" /> At least one ship of the same class was part of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance's]] fleet and participated in the [[Battle of Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTET Chapter 9" /> During the [[third Galactic War]], one of these ships served as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]]'s personal [[Ardinondu Daeruun's Flagship|flagship]].<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Objective Meridian|the Telos}}</ref>
